instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with knees bent at 90 degrees and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
2. Sit tall, brace your core, and place your hands on the bench for support.
3. Press your knees outward against the band as wide as you can.
4. Squeeze the outer hips at the end range.
5. Bring your knees back together slowly with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you press the knees out, inhale as you return.
2. Drive from the outer hips, not by leaning the torso.
3. Move slowly to keep constant tension on the band.
4. Keep your back tall and core braced throughout.
name: Resistance Band Seated Hip Abduction

instructions:
1. Anchor a band at shoulder height to your side.
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the band with the far hand, arm extended out to the side at shoulder height.
3. Keeping the arm straight, pull the band down and across toward your hip.
4. Squeeze the chest and lat at the bottom.
5. Return the arm to the side at shoulder height with control.
6. Repeat, then switch sides.
tips:
1. Move slowly and with control to maximize tension.
2. Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return.
3. Keep the working arm straight throughout.
4. Choose a band that challenges you without breaking form.
name: Resistance Band Shoulder Adduction

instructions:
1. Place a loop band around your thighs just above the knees and lie on your side with knees bent 90 degrees, legs stacked.
2. Prop up on your forearm with the elbow under the shoulder, and lift your hips slightly off the floor.
3. Keeping the knees bent, raise the top knee against the band while lifting the hips until the torso is straight.
4. Squeeze the glutes at the top.
5. Lower the leg and hips back down with control.
6. Repeat, then switch sides.
tips:
1. Drive from the outer glute, not by rolling backward.
2. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
3. Keep a steady pace for constant band tension.
4. Keep the elbow stacked under the shoulder.
name: Resistance Band Side Plank Glute Raise

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
2. Keep your chest up and bring your hands to your chest.
3. Lower into a squat by bending the knees and pushing the hips back.
4. Push the knees outward against the band as you descend.
5. Drive through your heels to stand back up.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the chest up and lean slightly forward.
2. Press the knees out so they track over the toes.
3. Exhale as you stand, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep the band taut throughout to engage the glutes.
name: Resistance Band Squat

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
2. Keep your chest up and bring your hands to your chest.
3. Lower into a squat by bending the knees and pushing the hips back.
4. Explosively jump up, extending the legs fully and pressing the knees out against the band.
5. Land softly back into the squat, absorbing through the legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Land softly with knees slightly bent to absorb impact.
2. Press the knees out against the band on takeoff and landing.
3. Exhale as you jump, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep the chest up and core braced throughout.
name: Resistance Band Squat Jump
